integrity: Complete embedded files with independently computed byte lengths and SHA-256; exact-arithmetic verifier with standalone stdlib execution; no independent scientific audit.
scientific_limitations: Uniform finite Dyck excursions only; no weighted paths, no general positive association for different nonmonotone functions. All-order conclusion is a proof, not an extrapolation from finite tests. Earlier LGV and Catalan symmetry results create residual historical-priority uncertainty.
title: Total nonnegativity and exact rank of the first-ascent–last-descent Dyck kernel
